answer.text:
According to Levi Strauss & Co.'s consolidated statements of income and the SG&A discussion in its 2024 Form 10-K:

* **Selling, general and administrative (SG&A) expenses:** **$3,246.2 million** for the fiscal year ended December 1, 2024 (Accession: 0000094845-25-000005, Filing Summary, chunk_index: 29 and chunk_index: 44).
* **Percentage of net revenues:** **51.1%** (Accession: 0000094845-25-000005, Filing Summary, chunk_index: 29).

### Calculation Check:
$$\frac{\text{Total SG\&A expenses}}{\text{Net revenues}} = \frac{\$3,246.2\text{ million}}{\$6,355.3\text{ million}} \approx 51.0786\% \rightarrow 51.1\%$$
